newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt pound overnight little changed in tight mark.
newsitem.headline: Egypt pound overnight little changed in tight mark.

text.p: Overnight interbank rates on the Egyptian pound were little changed in the private sector on Tuesday in a very tight market, bankers aid.
Bankers quoted rates between 10-1/4 and 10-3/8 percent, from a range of 10 to 10-1/2 percent on Monday, but some said funds remained difficult to find.
One-week rates averaged slightly higher, at between 10-1/4 and 10 7/16, from between 10-1/8 and 10-1/4 percent on Monday.
